description: a giant sea cucumber as big as a log, a thick leathery dark red-brown body covered in pale warts and rows of tiny tube feet, a crown of branched pale feathery tentacles around its mouth at the front, sticky white threads shooting out of it, rearing up its front end, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone, no water, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
